✅ Nexos.ai (Exclusive 76% Off): https://meticsmedia.com/nexos-QQQ

top_reply.author: @MeticsMedia
top_reply.text:
The whole idea behind Nexos is having everything in one secure place, so the agents you build are meant to run inside the platform where you get the model flexibility, the integrations, and the security all together. That's really its strength, especially for teams that want one central hub instead of juggling separate tools.

If your specific goal is an agent that runs fully on its own outside any platform, that's just a different use case, and you'd want a self hosted setup like OpenClaw or Hermes Agent where you run everything yourself on your own machine or a VPS. We've got tutorials on those too if that's the direction you want to go. Both approaches are solid, it just comes down to whether you want an all in one hub or full standalone control.

- Caleb

top_reply.author: @MeticsMedia
top_reply.text:
Good question! Botpress and Nexos are aimed at slightly different things. Botpress is more of a dedicated chatbot builder with a drag and drop flow editor, great if your main goal is building conversational bots for things like customer support or lead capture. Nexos is more of an all in one AI platform that gives you access to lots of different models from providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google in one place, plus AI agents and workflow automation. So if you specifically want to build chatbots, Botpress is worth a look. If you want a single hub to work across multiple AI models and automate broader tasks, that's where Nexos fits. Depends on what you're trying to build!

- Caleb
